selection_sources: all train180 raw physical trajectories, deduplicated between A/B
all development16 initial states x 6 complete policies =96 trajectories
terminal_role: 96 completed heldout rollouts; descriptive application of frozen rules only; never used to choose triggers or pilot seeds
near_steps_mode: use recorded native count, preserve force_consecutive=false

opening_command.reference: relative to most recent stable held grasp command; signed hand joint distance toward task open pose

slip.reference: object pose relative to palm; stable grasp reference before near-goal gate
slip.interpretation: relative motion only, may be commanded reorientation or release, not automatically accidental slip

gate_event: record first entry, first exit before native first-subgoal confirmation, repeated entries and native cumulative counter; do not infer consecutive requirement
missing_data: unknown, never count absent fields as false
pilot_selection: choose only after all training/development retrospective counts; no optimizer updates or full retraining
